title: CHORD KNOBS
author: jack
description: MIDI track TRIG page: NOT2 and NOT3 on knobs G and H (semitone offsets -12..+12, 0 = off). No step held: stamped into every new trig. Step(s) held: shows and edits the held steps' chords. Uses the Digitone's own per-step chord storage, so projects stay stock-compatible. Pressing knob G / H resets NOT2 / NOT3 to off.
